ideas.idea: Replace the placeholder quay.example domain in sitemap, robots and canonicals with the real domain, ideally from one shared setting
ideas.why: The domain is hardcoded in several files, but the report itself can't tell whether it is a placeholder, so this is a cleanup that may not be needed.

ideas.idea: Product JSON-LD on /shop is the wrong type for a category listing; use ItemList or give each product its own page with price and availability
ideas.why: /shop lists a whole category, so a single Product with only a name is a poor fit, and ItemList is a concrete alternative.

ideas.idea: Give each product its own page that the shop and home page link to
ideas.why: The site has only three routes and no product-level URLs, so there is nothing for crawlers or AI tools to index or cite per product.

ideas.idea: Publish delivery details (cutoff times, regions, cost) as text on a dedicated page, since the delivery notice is hidden from snippets
ideas.why: The 'shipped next day' claim has no supporting detail anywhere, and the only delivery text is in the nosnippet element, so a separate page would help.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD with the store name and URL
ideas.why: No site-identity structured data exists and the store name only appears in the home page title, so this is specific and low-cost.

ideas.idea: Make titles say who and what, e.g. 'Shop all marine parts | Quay'
ideas.why: The /shop title 'Shop all parts' leaves out the brand and the marine context, and the home page title already includes 'Quay'.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to sitemap URLs
ideas.why: Accurate, since neither URL has a date, but lastmod has little effect on a two-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag in app.html
ideas.why: app.html sets only charset, so mobile rendering and mobile-friendliness are affected.

ideas.idea: Wrap page content in a <main> landmark in the layout
ideas.why: The layout renders children with no <main>, so assistive tech and parsers can't identify the primary content.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap automatically instead of hand-writing it
ideas.why: With only two static pages the hand-written file is fine, and this only matters once product pages exist.
/search is a deliberate noindex page, so a description would do nothing and the report shouldn't treat its absence as a problem.

ideas.idea: Remove ssr=false or prerender the pages, and check for browser-only APIs
ideas.why: This duplicates the known ssr=false problem, so it should be left out; the only new part is the browser-API caveat, which is generic.
